entities.summary: Franz Uri Boas was a German-American anthropologist and ethnomusicologist. He was a pioneer of modern anthropology who has been called the "Father of American Anthropology". His work is associated with the movements known as historical particularism and cultural relativism. Franz Boas was a writers & intellectuals from Minden (1858-07-09, Minden–1942-12-21). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
